title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1973-03-19

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with generally good fidelity, highlighted by a sweet Box of Rain, powerful He's Gone tribute, and an especially loopy Loose Lucy.
ai_review.review: The set captures a classic early‑'73 Dead show – the band is in solid form, delivering standout moments like Box of Rain, China Cat Sunflower’s intro, He’s Gone (dedicated to Pigpen), Trucking, The Other One and a slow‑burning Loose Lucy.  Most listeners praise the tape’s clear levels and decent soundboard quality, though one reviewer initially thought the playback was too fast.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviews rate the show 3‑5 stars and note good to excellent soundboard quality; only a single low‑star comment about speed, which is contradicted by later reviewers.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear levels and near‑perfect instrument/vocal balance; some listeners perceived pitch/speed issues, but others confirm the tape plays at correct speed. Slight volume loss likely due to tape age.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set focused show with strong transitions; many fans recall the China Cat intro leading into He’s Gone and a smooth flow through Trucking, The Other One and Loose Lucy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: One reviewer felt Jerry sounded 'chipmunk‑like' due to perceived speed issues; another says his tone was fine and the tape playback is correct.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised Phil’s bass (and piano) trading licks and noted his vocals were surprisingly on key during Box of Rain.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboard work highlighted in the Box of Rain interplay and the slower, looser version of Loose Lucy; levels for keyboards reported as near perfect.
